verdicts.reason: Both use the same broken leaderboard approach. Each crams six columns into 90px: the SOLSTICE wordmark is tiny and sits low in the dark tile, the 4-line headline competes with the body copy, 'Ships late June' wraps into a one-word-per-line stack, and the fine print is illegible and as prominent as the CTA, which is a small button pushed into the corner. A is marginally worse because 'Ships late June' is jammed between the body copy and the legal text with almost no gutter. B gives it slightly more room, but B's headline runs almost into the body column.
